findings.issue: The NSW citation is bare and mis-targeted: Ch. I §5 is change of groups in profinite cohomology (restriction/corestriction), and this file contains no cohomology — only subgroup indices of cyclotomic character images. summary: Every new declaration carries an accurate docstring, but two module docstrings are now incomplete: FiniteExtension.lean's "Main results" list omits the two theorems this PR adds, and Index.lean has no main-declarations list and never announces the ℚ_p image identification it proves. Its reference block is also bare and cites a cohomology section that supports nothing in the file.
